questions.question: Is the wool ethically certified by global standards?
questions.answer: 100% certified under the Responsible Wool Standard (RWS), ensuring animal welfare and sustainable land management.

questions.question: What express delivery timeframes apply internationally?
questions.answer: DHL Express international transit takes 2-4 business days with end-to-end carbon-neutral shipping.

questions.question: How do I choose between regular and tall fit lengths?
questions.answer: Tall fits feature an additional 5cm in body length and 3cm in sleeve length, recommended for individuals 6'2" (188cm) and above.
